test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the Director General of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Shekhar Mande.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of India's leading experts in DNA fingerprinting and diagnostics**, Dr. Shekhar Mande** assumed the charge on 16th October 2018.
 
• **The Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR)**, is known for its cutting-edge R&D knowledge base in diverse S&T areas.
 
• As of April 2022, there are **38 research laboratories **under CSIR in entire India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Senior scientist Nallathamby Kalaiselvi was on 6 August 2022 appointed as the first woman Director General of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• She succeeds Shekhar Mande, who superannuated in April 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samir Kumar Brahmachari **is an Indian biophysicist and Former Director General of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research.
 
• **Dr. RA Mashelkar **is an Indian Chemical Engineer, born in the village Mashel in Goa and brought up in Maharashtra.
 
• **Dr. SK Joshi **was an Indian physicist.
